children: StoneBridge Acquisition II made available its PFIC Annual Information Statement and disclosed per-share, per-day ordinary earnings of $0.0004338983 for 2025.
PFIC Annual Information Statement provided to Class A shareholders to assist with a QEF election under Section 1295.
Disclosed ordinary earnings per Class A share per day of $0.0004338983 for the 2025 taxable year.
No cash or property distributions were made to shareholders during the 2025 taxable period.
Company does not admit PFIC status and urges shareholders to consult tax advisors on QEF and U.S. tax consequences.
